pb-seller-connectors.title: Store connections
pb-seller-connectors.approval: Each store read and change asks first. An uncertain change is never sent again.
pb-seller-connectors.rehearsal: This browser rehearsal cannot connect to a real store. Use the desktop or hosted app for qualified provider access.
pb-seller-connectors.shopifyHelp: Use an app in your own Shopify organization. Its credentials stay in this open session. Other merchants need their own approved access.
pb-seller-connectors.ownStore: This app and store belong to my Shopify organization
pb-seller-connectors.complete: Complete the exact store details and confirm ownership first.
pb-seller-connectors.questionApproval: Every buyer question waits for your approval of that exact question, model and maximum cost. Opening the assistant never approves future AI calls.
pb-seller-connectors.legal: A named lawyer must confirm the purpose notice and consent rule before buyers can use the assistant. That review is still pending.
pb-seller-connectors.assistantManual: Meanwhile, link buyers to your shop and answer them yourself. The assistant never places orders or charges buyers.
pb-seller-connectors.missing: This open order is no longer available.
pb-seller-connectors.error.SHOPIFY_API_R: Shopify did not confirm this request. Check the store, credentials and app access.
pb-seller-connectors.error.SHOPIFY_SETUP: Use your own store and its exact app credentials.
pb-seller-connectors.error.APPROVAL_STAL: The store or approval changed. Read it again before continuing.
pb-seller-connectors.error.generic: This request could not finish. Read the current store details and try again. An uncertain write will not be resent.
pb-seller-connectors.partial: This catalogue is incomplete. No total is shown.
pb-seller-connectors.completeCatalogue: All returned catalogue pages were read.
pb-seller-connectors.breakEvenHelp: Owner source amount for this product. Leave blank if unknown. Price changes need a known break-even amount.
pb-seller-connectors.field.title: Product title
pb-seller-connectors.clearance: I explicitly approve selling below break-even as clearance
pb-seller-connectors.reviewLocked: Read the current product and review its source receipt first. Changed inputs need a new preview.
pb-seller-connectors.state.applied: Shopify confirmed the change and read-back
pb-seller-connectors.state.rejected: Change refused; it will not be resent
pb-seller-connectors.unknown: Inspect Shopify before doing anything else. This change cannot be sent again.
pb-seller-connectors.providerDisclosure: The buyer question and public products go to your chosen API model only after approval. Provider retention follows your account terms. Chausar deletes buyer text when the session ends.
pb-seller-connectors.assistantActive: Assistant is open for approved questions
pb-seller-connectors.catalogueAge: This exact catalogue is usable for fifteen minutes. Read it again by approving the settings before it becomes stale.
pb-seller-connectors.hostedOnly: Opening the assistant requires the hosted app. Link to the shop meanwhile.
pb-seller-connectors.costRule: Code computes the maximum estimate from the approved input allowance, output cap and rate. Actual usage settles after the call.
pb-seller-connectors.error.RULE_UNCONFIR: A named lawyer must confirm the buyer notice and model handling first.
pb-seller-connectors.error.STOREFRONT_CA: The catalogue is too old. Approve a fresh read before opening the assistant.
pb-seller-connectors.error.STOREFRONT_SE: This buyer session ended. Its question cannot be approved.
pb-seller-connectors.error.BUDGET_REACHE: This request exceeds the approved model limit. No new call was sent.
